The project focuses on improving food quality and safety, benefiting local consumers by providing access to high-quality, safe, and nutritious food. It aims to enhance public health outcomes and raise consumer expectations. KABCO will act as an aggregator, developing underutilized lands into hi-tech agricultural farms and engaging farmer groups through Service Level Agreements. The project will also ensure market demand alignment through business-intelligence-driven cropping and develop forward linkages, including export-market integration.
